doc: Ascent of a cyclone one tenth of a nanoradian from the pole: east norm 1e-10, still below 1e-9, so the fallback, age 0.8, 41 x 41 float32 patch of half-angle 0.5 rad around it. The branch decides which way the comma head shifts. The cases at 1e-10 and 1e-8 only bracket the threshold to within a decade; the ascent.cyclone.pole_colat_* cases pin the 1e-9 of the code to 1e-5 relative. Conventions of cloudgen.sphere read here: lonlat_to_dir(lon, lat) = (cos lat cos lon, cos lat sin lon, sin lat) with float64 numpy cos and sin (right-handed, z north, longitude grows east; a vortex center is that direction); normalize(v) = v / |v| (plain division, no epsilon: a zero vector gives NaN). Tolerance rtol 5e-5, atol 5e-6: over the single-vortex float32 cases the float64-promoted computation differs by at most 3.1e-7 and a one-ulp nudge of the directions by 9e-7 (the oldest low, 0.44 of the default band); tolerance 10 times the worst, rounded up.

params.dtype_chain: p float32: a = float32 zeros; per vortex the center is cast to float32, d2, exp and the gaussians are float32 (a cyclone takes _comma_ascent, float32; a tropical subtracts its float32 eye); the term is np.float32(ascent) * g.astype(float32) and a += term accumulates in float32, in vortex order.
